void TransformCachedShellMeshDTOs (devDept.Geometry.Transformation transform, int? logicalPartIndex=null, string? partSource=null)
 Applies a geometric transformation to the cached shell mesh DTOs. ◆ TransformCachedShellMeshDTOs()

void HirEV_SmartFitSystemsApp.ViewModel.MainViewModel.TransformCachedShellMeshDTOs ( devDept.Geometry.Transformation transform,
int? logicalPartIndex = null,
string? partSource = null )
private

Applies a geometric transformation to the cached shell mesh DTOs. This keeps the cached DTOs in sync with the live geometry after move-to-origin or object manipulator operations, so that SaveCurrentSession can fall back to accurate data even after Entities.Regen() has destroyed standalone Mesh vertices.

Parâmetros
transformThe transformation to apply to cached DTO vertex positions.
logicalPartIndexOptional logical part index to filter. If null, applies to all.
partSourceOptional part source identifier to filter.
